correctness.rationale: Explicit hub singleton criterion follows directly from open neighborhoods. For n>=5 a unique singleton forces 2-colour alternation on the deleted-vertex path, giving 24n named PCF states; small orders counted separately. Only recolouring an alternating path colour to old singleton can preserve properness; its old multiplicity must be two. Hence all n>=7 are frozen, n=5,6 are degree-two. Explicit 15-word orbit plus colour swap classifies n=5; invariant triple-use colour and singleton parity classify six 6-cycles for each fixed hub at n=6. The packaged independent-definition checker directly enumerates all PCF states and moves at n=3..11; finite checks corroborate, not extend, universal proof.

value.rationale: At the minimum palette of a natural infinite family, this completely classifies the reconfiguration graph and proves a sharp transition from all-mobile states on two exceptional rim orders to total freezing at every larger order, including exact connected-component sizes. The transition determines local navigability under an invariant that ordinary proper-coloring connectivity does not capture. It is not merely recomputation of a previously known chromatic number.
